title: Why Does Your Brain Replay Songs?
description: Ever had a song stuck in your head? Discover the fascinating science behind earworms. #Psychology #BrainFacts #Shorts
scenes: Ever had a song stuck in your head?
You are doing something completely different...
But suddenly, that same little tune starts playing in your mind.
Your brain can replay a catchy musical pattern without actually hearing it.
Repetition, simple melodies, and memorable rhythms can make songs easier to remember.
Sometimes, even a small reminder can bring the tune back.
So, what song is stuck in your head right now?
